# LawStaff Group

> LawStaff Group is a platform for fractional and part-time business counsel and legal talent, and a full-service legal recruiting firm, powered by NorthPoint, placing top-tier legal professionals on a temporary, temp-to-hire and direct-hire basis since 2003. Based in Atlanta, GA.

## Fractional counsel and legal talent platform
Businesses retain fractional counsel, paralegals, contract administrators and legal assistants by the hour, week or month. LawStaff Group runs the backend of every engagement — client invoicing, payroll, employer taxes and insurance — for a set percentage platform fee, so the professionals just do the work.
- Engagements: fractional general counsel, part-time in-house counsel, project counsel, interim and leave coverage, and part-time or project-based legal support.
- Vetting: every professional completes a step-by-step application and records a video interview. LawStaff confirms bar admissions for attorneys and checks references before presenting anyone.
- Pricing: each professional sets their rate; the client pays one all-in rate (rate plus platform fee) on one invoice. Free for professionals to apply, with no membership dues.
- Independence: LawStaff Group never directs an attorney's legal work or professional judgment. LawStaff Group is a legal staffing company, not a law firm, and does not provide legal advice.

## Who we place
Attorneys, paralegals, legal secretaries, legal administrators, litigation support, legal office services, legal nurse consultants and legal IT professionals.

## Hiring solutions
- Temporary placement: coverage for absences, special projects, leave and trial preparation. We handle payroll, workers' compensation, employer taxes and unemployment insurance.
- Temp-to-hire: evaluate a candidate's work before hiring full time.
- Direct hire: pre-screened candidates matched to your job description, backed by a replacement guarantee.
- Payroll services: we payroll a candidate you have already found.

## How we work
We interview every candidate, qualify their skills, test their abilities and check references. Clients are only presented with pre-screened, qualified candidates.

Customized screening questionnaires: for every search we build a screening questionnaire with the client's input, and the candidate's answers are submitted with every résumé, saving clients review time.

Video introductions: every candidate is invited to film an optional video introduction, so clients can see how they communicate before the first call.
